description: List keys in your memory locker (sorted, up to limit per call). While next_after is not null, call again with after = next_after for the next page.

after.description: next_after of your previous call: only keys after it.

instance_id.description: Utility instance id from buy or list_utilities.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if you have no app sign-in and cannot send a header.

prefix.description: Only keys starting with this, e.g. "notes/".

name: locker_list
title: List my memory locker
